sentences.text:
Abhijit Mondal vs Unknown on 5 November, 2024
05.11.2024
Ct. No. 28
Sl No. 81
Sb
 Crm (Db) 3159 of 2024

In Re: - An application for bail under Section 483 of the B.N.S.S. 2023
 (previously section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure) in
 connection with Ranaghat P.S. Case No. 658/2023 dated 08.10.2023
 under Sections 498A/307/302 of Indian Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of: Abhijit Mondal
 Mr. Soubhik Meter
 Mr. Nilendra Narayan Ray ... for the petitioner
 Mr. Arijit Ganguly
 Ms. Pinky Sarkar
 ...for the Stat
 1.
Heard learned lawyers for both the parties.
2. Petitioner is in custody for about more than a year.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the State submits date has been fixed for recording of evidence.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Statement of the witness shows petitioner had assaulted his wife and other in-laws.
He also assaulted his son resulting in his death.
5. In view of nature of offence and as date has been fixed for recording evidence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
6. Accordingly the application for bail, is thus, rejected.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
